# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay away from the whole site. The site is also a browser-only React app, so even a crawler that got in would see an empty page. The only unknown is the canonical link (GEO-015), because no site domain is declared. All results were read from code. No live check was run. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking all crawlers in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` tells search engines and AI search tools not to read any page. That also makes both routes conflict with being found (GEO-009 and GEO-014). - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59. This removes the 40-point cap, which applied because a search crawler is blocked site-wide (GEO-009's blocker). It assumes you want to be found. If the block is intentional, tell me and I'll change the GEO-009 and GEO-014 results. ### 2. Put the page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** many crawlers don't run JavaScript. They see only an empty `
`. The catalogue list is also fetched in the browser after the page loads. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:5-7` - **What the code says:** `
` and `useEffect(() => { fetch('/api/mugs')...` - **Size:** Large. Prerender or server-render the routes, for example with a prerender plugin or a framework such as Next.js or Remix. - **Score after this:** 37–46 on its own. A live check would confirm the ratio of raw to rendered text. ### 3. Give every page a description and set the page language - **Why it matters:** the title is the generic "Vite App", there is no meta description, and `` has no `lang`. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `` and `Vite App` - **Size:** Small. Add `lang="en"`, a real title and a description. Use a head helper such as react-helmet-async for per-route values. - **Score after this:** 33–41 on its own. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and within size limits | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`, 2 lines, valid syntax | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access your policy says | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:1-2`, `User-agent: *` / `Disallow: /`.
